args.lesson: bursty_offload (bursts of 8, Poisson 2 req/us, p99<=0.4us): full 400-eval run_dse produced a 43-design feasible front; the min-luts_plus_ffs winner was pipelined_m data_width=16,n_iter=12,angle_guard=-1,frac_guard=1,rounding=trunc,m=6 (786 LUT+FF, 10.1 bits, 68.5 Msps, err 9.01e-4, sys_p99 0.195us simulated vs 0.146 analytic bound). L2 simulation inflated p99 by ~34% but all top-5 still passed; L3/L4/L5 had no recorded rows (no_measured_data), so no winner change and no reexplore. Lesson: for this spec class the analytic sys bound is optimistic by ~1.3-1.4x; leave headroom, and pipelined_m with m=6 dominates m=7/8 on latency.
